exact_generation_prompt: FRONT VIEW face level directly toward camera, both eyes visible, no turn. Create ONE separate new original realistic sharp editorial haircut photograph of a fictional ADULT woman. STRICT COMPOSITION: HEAD AND NECK WITH ONLY TOP SHOULDER LINE; bottom frame ends immediately below the shoulders, no bust, chest or torso. BULKY VERY LOOSE fully opaque ivory HIGH TURTLENECK with broad folded collar covers neck base and all upper chest, unshaped fabric, no neckline/cleavage/fitted contours/sleeveless. Entire head and all hair edges with generous crown and side margin. Light neutral studio background and soft daylight; all face/hair sharp at genuine native supported resolution >=1024 longedge; full portrait 4:5 source aspect. No upscaling/8K, blur/grain/fog, collage, text, logo, watermark, jewellery or celebrity likeness. A fictional ADULT Black woman with warm dark skin and brown eyes, age 35. PRIMARY thin-hair styling constraint: fine wispy LIGHT LOW-DENSITY hair, modest airy low-volume mass, separate thin sections, small scalp glimpses along part, natural full hairline, no medical depiction, no thick/dense/heavy dome or fringe. Natural brunette hair, distinct flowing S-waves, not ringlets. LONGER bob-like upper/temple pieces, COMPACT ROUNDED crown and SOFT TAPERED SHORT PIXIE-LENGTH NAPE. UPPER SECTIONS retain bob-like length and movement above a visibly shorter tapered pixie nape; genuine BOB-PIXIE HYBRID, not ordinary bob, close pixie or long wolf cut. Long divided airy forehead pieces open over middle forehead, eyes unobscured. Ear edges visible.
